name: Interpretative phenomenological analysis
summary: A close reading of one person's account at a time, moving from notes to experiential statements to themes for that person, and only then looking across people.

seed_codes.name: Descriptive note
seed_codes.definition: A note about the content: what the person said, the events and things they talk about.

seed_codes.name: Linguistic note
seed_codes.definition: A note about how it is said: word choice, metaphor, tone, pauses, repetition.

seed_codes.name: Conceptual note
seed_codes.definition: A note about your interpretation: what it might mean to the person, at a more abstract level.

notes: The three note types above are added as codes when you choose this method. Use them on each line of the account.

Not yet built for this method: keeping one case open at a time until its themes are set, and holding back the cross-case table until every case is done. Work through the phases in order to keep to the method.

phases.title: Case by case: exploratory notes
phases.goal: Read one account closely and annotate it with descriptive, linguistic, and conceptual notes.
memo_prompts: What is this person's world like, in their own terms?
exit_checklist: Added all three kinds of notes to each part of it

phases.title: Experiential statements
phases.goal: Turn the notes into short statements that capture what the person's experience was like.
memo_prompts: Does each statement stay close to the person's words and still say something interpretive?
exit_checklist: Wrote experiential statements for this case
Kept the link from each statement to its extract

phases.title: Personal experiential themes
phases.goal: Cluster the statements into themes for this one person.
memo_prompts: Which statements belong together, and what names them?
exit_checklist: Tabled each theme with its extracts

phases.title: Group experiential themes
phases.goal: Only after every case is done, look for patterns across the cases while keeping each person's account visible.
memo_prompts: Where do accounts converge, and where do they differ?
exit_checklist: Kept extracts from each case in every group theme
